comparison.objective: Strip a measured length of cable insulation in a lever-operated station; candidate screens ceramic media from steel workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable insertion, coordinated lever hold, resisted withdrawal, and release versus dual-tab grasping, load sharing, tilting/agitation, and screen reseating.
comparison.success_condition: 8–12 mm stripped with lever raised and hands clear versus ≥98% media recovered, washers retained, no spill/damage, screen supported, and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared only at a generic level; resisted stripping and selective screening are different physical mechanisms. Missing rubric details: none material.
